finding: The first publication junction test pre-created the canonical filename as a victim. An unsafe followed-junction write could then fail on AlreadyExists/readback without proving containment, leaving a false-positive negative assertion.
fix: Keep a separate outside-victim.json sentinel, leave the requested canonical filename absent, assert publication errors AND the canonical file was never created, and preserve sentinel bytes/identity and directory entry count.
scope: Only strengthens the new Windows publication regression, no product or existing assertion change.
ciBinding: First PR run is for 51bbb209. Strengthened test requires a new source/material request and a new current-head Windows CI; do not reuse the first run as final proof.
